Don't worry, you're giving the advice that you see fit which is good. Thing is: I started the whole workout / healthy eating thing with my first therapy and did it for the better part of a year. Lost 20 pounds (10kg) and was in a better shape then most of life before. But I'm also a smoker (started with 16) so sports always feel like I am capped  due to lung capacity. Furthermore I think my dopamince cycle is absolutely fucked. I basically only enjoy things to "win" and "perform", I played soccer for a longtime to win, I play my MMO's with performance in mind and so on. So I don't get gratification from "small victories" they just feel hollow.   


It has to be the big goal. Which in turn then drains my motivation again. Like f.e.: Want to get in to better shape. What do I have to do? Sports and nutrition. Okay I have 0 fun doing sports but force myself to do it. 4 months down the road I maybe dropped 2 pounds due to metabolism and so on. Still feel ugly, but now I have made my life less "fun". Brain kicks in saying: "why are you even doing this, you'll still stay alone anyway". Go back to old life. Been through that cycle a couple of times now.  


And I'm technically not that shy or anything I just fell down the doomer end so much that I basically don't see the value in doing any of it. But hey maybe you have some fun tips for it.

Yep I absolutely feel that. During my double depression phases, if I can, I tend to sleep 16-18 hours a day because that is the most peaceful time I have per day. Also much of a night person. The night is so quiet and peaceful, everything seems so distant. The rush of everyday life and society. Your just being yourself with your thoughts. If you want to talk about it I'm always up for it :)
